beats.text: Every time you try to make everyone happy, you get more tired.
beats.why: Sets the core cost of people-pleasing: exhaustion as the first symptom the viewer will recognize.
metaphorHints: battery draining with each added face
figure stretched toward many directions at once
beats.abstractMeaning: Approval-seeking consumes energy faster than it returns anything

timing.text: Every time you try to make everyone happy, you get more tired.

beats.text: You change your answer to match whoever asked.
beats.why: Names the behavior itself — shape-shifting speech — so the viewer sees their own habit clearly.
metaphorHints: answer mutating like liquid to fit each mold
mirror reflecting a different face per viewer
beats.abstractMeaning: Identity bends to whichever audience is present

timing.text: You change your answer to match whoever asked.

beats.why: The consequence: credibility decays into noise — the emotional low point of the setup.
metaphorHints: rubber stamp imprint fading with each press
beats.abstractMeaning: Conditional agreement loses all value and trust

beats.text: Meanwhile the people who never change their mind are the ones others remember.
beats.why: The contrast beat — conviction is what earns memory and recognition.
beats.abstractMeaning: Consistency produces recognition; compliance produces invisibility

timing.text: Meanwhile the people who never change their mind are the ones others remember.

beats.text: Stop editing yourself for an audience that will not applaud anyway.
beats.why: The reframe — the audience you perform for gives nothing, so the performance is pointless.
metaphorHints: empty theater seats, hands that never clap
red pen striking through a self-portrait
beats.abstractMeaning: Unrewarded approval-seeking is a performance without an audience

timing.text: Stop editing yourself for an audience that will not applaud anyway.

beats.text: Your turn: choose one direction and stay with it.
beats.why: The call to action — commit to a single bearing and hold, closing the arc from drift to resolve.
metaphorHints: forked path collapsing into a single straight line
beats.abstractMeaning: Commitment and self-alignment as the way out

timing.text: Your turn: choose one direction and stay with it.
